## Summary

State the problem and the responsibility change in reviewer-facing language.

## Retained contract and effect

- What remains true or compatible?
- What will a user, operator, or downstream owner observe?

## Evidence

- Focused checks and their results.
- Source, test, measurement, or review evidence needed to support material
  claims.

## Deliberate exclusions

- What this pull request does not implement or claim.
- Deferred work and its existing owner, when relevant.

## Review focus

- The smallest set of decisions or risks that needs reviewer attention.
